blocks.content: The historical mission ledger preserves N/M/P/Q checklists and the v5 R1–R14 registry. R12 native Windows/Linux acceptance remains in progress; later entries cover Document Kit and skill import. Historical verified labels are not a current security certification: OPEN_SOURCE_READINESS.md records newly identified gaps and current test results without rewriting old receipts.
A fresh session reads STATUS.md, skips done items, continues at the first pending one.
The why behind non-obvious implementations — required by the unattended working rules.
